visualCharacteristics.purpose: Feature/pillar cards with a small line icon, heading, short text and arrow link; 4 across on desktop
visualCharacteristics.description: New variant (no existing cards variants in project): White elevated cards with small line icon on top, H3, text and arrow link; 4 across Page background; four white cards with line icons, overlapping the hero above.

cells: text: optional date/eyebrow, heading, description, CTA link

contentPattern.structure: one row per card: cell 1 icon image (optional); cell 2 H3, short text, trailing link paragraph as CTA

reuseGuidance: Reuse for icon-led feature grids. For photo-led news/event cards use cards-news.
